verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਤ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸੋਧਿ ਕੈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: got aThaareh sodh kai paRai puraan aThaareh bhaiee|

en.bdb: Thoroughly understanding the eighteen gotras (sub castes) the gurmukhs go through the eighteen puranas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨੀ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲੰਘਿ ਬਾਈ ਉਮਰੇ ਸਾਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: aunee veeh ikeeh la(n)gh baiee umare saadh nivaiee|

en.bdb: Jumping over nineteen, twenty and twenty-one they arrive at twenty-two.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਲੁਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੇਈ ਚੌਵੀ ਪੰਜੀਹ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh asa(n)kh luTai kai teiee chauavee pa(n)jeeh paiee|

en.bdb: They make the numbers twenty-three, twenty-four and twenty-five meaningful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਬੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਤਾਈਹਾ ਆਇ ਅਠਾਈਹ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chhabee joR sataieehaa aai aThaieeh mel milaiee|

en.bdb: In the name of twenty-six, twenty-seven, twenty-eight they meet the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਣਤੀਹ ਤੀਹ ਸਾਧਿ ਲੰਘਿ ਇਕਤੀਹ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: aula(n)gh unateeh teeh saadh la(n)gh ikateeh vajee vadhaiee|

en.bdb: Crossing twenty-nine, thirty and reaching thirty-one, in their heart they feel blest and delighted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੁਲਖਣ ਬਤੀਹੇ ਤੇਤੀਹ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadh sulakhan bateehe teteeh dhraoo chaufer firaiee|

en.bdb: Accomplishing the thirty-two saintly characteristics, like Dhru they make thirty-three crore gods and goddesses shake and revolve around (them).
Touching thirty-four they realize the  Invisible Lord i.e. the gurmukhs going above all the numbers get exhilerated in the love of Lord who is beyond all the counts.
